definitions.explanation: A sudden event causing widespread damage, destruction, or distress, including natural disasters and man-made catastrophes.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}に{備|そな}えて{非常食|ひじょうしょく}を{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: I prepared emergency food in case of a disaster.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}{災害|さいがい}で{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{被害|ひがい}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: Many people were affected by the natural disaster.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}{時|じ}の{避難|ひなん}{場所|ばしょ}を{確認|かくにん}しておこう。
examples.english: Let's check the evacuation site for emergencies.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{自然|しぜん}{災害|さいがい} (natural disaster)
・{災害|さいがい}{対策|たいさく} (disaster countermeasures)
・{災害|さいがい}{時|じ} (at the time of disaster)
・{災害|さいがい}に{備|そな}える (to prepare for a disaster)

TYPES OF DISASTERS:
・{地震|じしん} (earthquake)
・{台風|たいふう} (typhoon)
・{洪水|こうずい} (flood)
・{火災|かさい} (fire)
